source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def bands(length, separators):
        cuts = [-1, *separators, length]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)
                if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_bands = bands(h, sep_rows)
    col_bands = bands(w, sep_cols)
    tile_cells = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_bands for c0, c1 in col_bands
                  for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
    background = Counter(tile_cells).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_bands:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_bands:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] != background
                        for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if marks == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''

                if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_bands = bands(h, sep_rows)

    tile_cells = [grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_bands for c0, c1 in col_bands
